topic: Machu Picchu, Peru, 1400s: the Inca built this mountain city with stones cut so precisely they fit together without mortar.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: Machu Picchu’s Stone Puzzle

shots.narration: A sparkle jump lands us above the clouds!
shots.scene: Machu Picchu, Peru, 1400s; broad stone terrace surrounded by green mountain peaks, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock materialize together in swirling dust and golden sparkles.
shots.mood: Bright sunlight, brilliant blue watch glow, welcoming mountain adventure.

shots.narration: Welcome to Machu Picchu, Peru, in the 1400s.
shots.scene: Wide terrace overlooking Machu Picchu's stone buildings and green mountain slopes, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya spreads her arms toward the mountain city.
shots.mood: Golden sunlight, sweeping mountain grandeur, friendly excitement.

shots.narration: [excited] The Inca built this city high in the mountains!
shots.scene: Broad stone walkway among roofed stone buildings, with steep green peaks beyond, cinematic 3D, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Tock points toward the surrounding city with his spring tail.
shots.mood: Sunny stone textures, rich greenery, delighted discovery.

shots.narration: Zoya spots a puzzle hiding in plain sight.
shots.scene: Sheltered walkway beside a finely fitted Inca stone wall, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya leans toward the wall's narrow stone joints.
shots.mood: Warm reflected sunlight, curious expression, intriguing stone detail.

shots.narration: Where is the mortar between these stones?
shots.scene: Close view of Zoya beside tightly joined shaped stones, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya traces a stone joint through the air with her finger.
shots.mood: Raised eyebrows, clear stone seams, playful puzzlement.

shots.scene: Low section of finely fitted stone wall beside a level walkway, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Tock bends his round glass face toward a stone seam.
shots.mood: Sunlit brass reflections, close-up curiosity, gentle suspense.

shots.narration: The stones were cut to fit precisely together.
shots.scene: Extreme close view of shaped Inca stones with closely matching edges and no mortar, cinematic 3D, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: A small patch of sunlight travels across the fitted stone edges.
shots.mood: Crisp stone textures, warm light, satisfying visual discovery.

shots.narration: Their careful fit means no mortar is needed.
shots.scene: Tock beside the same tightly fitted stone wall, broad terrace floor below, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Tock points his spring tail at the bare stone joint.
shots.mood: Bright brass shine, clear visual explanation, cheerful confidence.

shots.narration: [surprised] So the missing mortar isn't missing at all!
shots.scene: Sunlit walkway beside the precisely joined wall, green mountains visible beyond, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya brings her hands together like matching stone edges.
shots.mood: Wide delighted smile, sunny colors, satisfying realization.

shots.narration: Zoya sees the whole wall differently now.
shots.scene: Long stretch of fitted stone masonry beside a spacious mountain-city terrace, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya sweeps her hand toward the wall in admiration.
shots.mood: Respectful wonder, warm stone surfaces, peaceful mountain air.

shots.narration: One mountain city, one beautifully solved stone puzzle.
shots.scene: Broad safe terrace overlooking Machu Picchu and sunlit green peaks, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Zoya taps her glowing blue wristwatch.
shots.mood: Golden travel sparkles, happy achievement, anticipation.

shots.scene: Machu Picchu terrace framed by distant green mountains and a halo of golden sparkles, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Tock turns his glass face toward Zoya to ask his question.
shots.mood: Bouncy curiosity, brilliant blue watch glow, inviting next-adventure energy.

episode.endHook: The blue watch sparkles again—where will their next adventure begin?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock sparkle into Machu Picchu, Peru, in the 1400s! Discover the Inca mountain city and solve the mystery of its precisely fitted stones.
